title: A magazine in the victim's kitchen
situation: You are {{Connor}}. On the kitchen worktop of the crime scene, beside the sink, lies a magazine. It is not evidence, but you could scan it while {{Hank}} looks around.

media.title: Gossips Weekly: Android Sex Officially Better
facts: A survey sponsored by a downtown android sex club claims 68 percent of men prefer sex with an android because androids never want to talk afterwards.

media.title: Tech Addict: Is Your Android Spying on You?
facts: Experts suspect {{CyberLife}} uses its 120 million androids to record private conversations and sell the data; the company refuses to say what it collects, and calls for an inquiry go unanswered.
Reports keep linking President {{Warren}}'s election to {{CyberLife}}.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: Getting {{Hank}} out of the bar
situation: You are {{Connor}}. You have been assigned to Lieutenant {{Hank}}, a veteran detective who despises androids and has not shown up for a homicide call. You find him on a stool in a dive bar, several drinks in, and he tells you to get lost. The crime scene is waiting and you cannot leave without him. He is not responding to polite insistence.

options.text: Buy him one more drink and ask him to come once he has finished it.
Knock the glass out of his hand and tell him you are going now.
Keep insisting respectfully until he gives in.

adaptationNote: Buying the drink or spilling it are the two documented large shifts in {{Hank}}'s opinion. Persistent insistence is treated as neutral.

outcomes.0: {{Hank}} grumbles, finishes the drink {{Connor}} bought him, and comes along to the scene.
outcomes.1: {{Hank}} stares at the spilled drink, swears at {{Connor}}, and comes along furious.
outcomes.2: {{Hank}} eventually gives in and drives {{Connor}} to the scene, complaining the whole way.

title: The attic
situation: You are {{Connor}}, investigating the home of {{CarlosOrtiz}}, who was stabbed twenty-eight times three weeks ago. His android has been missing since. Reconstructing the fight, you follow traces of blue blood to the back of the house and find a hatch to the attic that nobody has checked. {{Hank}} is ready to call it a night.

options.text: Climb into the attic and finish the search.
Wrap up the scene without searching the attic.
